backupLayout.bash: component-specific _backup_<version> names next to the tree

digestGate.bash: trusts the upstream installer's own verification
digestGate.go: sha256 and sizeBytes are mandatory and re-verified before any write

downgrade.bash: prints a warning and continues the update path with rc=0

healthRollback.bash: health check exists but rollback is an interactive path
healthRollback.go: automatic rollback to the backup with rc=6

restartScope.go: restarts only on a real systemd root; sandbox roots warn and skip

versionCompare.go: numeric per-component compare with v-prefix strip and zero padding
